comments.body:
@pcbeingused333 Thanks for contributing. I appreciate the fix, but there are a couple of things I'd like to be addressed before merging.

Please switch to the `supabase-js` rule you suggested. A path that stays inside the bucket should keep working; only throw when the key climbs above its bucket, including another bucket. That means `GetPublicUrl` doesn't start throwing for keys that work now.

There are also a couple of items I want to raise in regards with the repository's standards (see the Code Style section in [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-csharp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)):
- `Common/PathSegment.cs` already escapes a segment and rejects `.` and `..`. Please extend instead of adding a second `EncodeSegment` in `Helpers.cs`, and keep the new rule in one place. It should pass a `paramName` to `ArgumentException`, like the existing code does.
- No comments In code. Remove the one above `GetEncodedPath`, and either document it in a proper XML documentation or a proper declarative name.
- Tests:
    - Avoid unnecessary blank lines between arrange, act and assert
    - Assert on the expression directly, not through dedicated locals
    - One assertion per test. The dot-segment test loops over three keys, in a parameterised test which relies on a `switch` expression for each parameter
    - Replace the `Send` switch by something that doesn't dispatch on operation names
    - Cover both sides of the new boundary: `a/../b` is allowed and `../b` is rejected

Happy to help if necessary.

Done, pushed as a new commit:

- Dot segments that stay inside the bucket work again (`a/../b` requests `b`, including from `GetPublicUrl`). Only a key that climbs above its bucket throws. This also covers `../bucket/a.png`, which leaves the bucket before coming back; I can allow that if you prefer.
- The rule and the escaping are now in `Common/PathSegment.cs`, with `paramName`; `Helpers.EncodePath` is gone.
- Comments removed and the helper renamed to `EscapeForRequestUrl`.
- The key tests are in `StorageObjectKeyTests`: delegates instead of the operation-name switch, one assertion per test, both sides of the boundary.

I re-ran the gate with `--fast` (640 unit and contract tests pass) and `--mutation` (no survivors on changed lines). E2E was not re-run locally for this commit.


This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
@pcbeingused333  Thanks for addressing those. There's one conflict to address, `StorageBucketApi` has been reorganised in the meantime.

Merged `master` and resolved the conflict in `StorageBucketApi.cs`. One related adjustment: the purge URL there on `master` used `Helpers.EncodePath`, which this PR removes, so it now uses `PathSegment.EscapeObjectPath`. `gate.sh packages/Storage --fast` passes (801 unit and contract tests); E2E and mutation tests were not re-run for the merge.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
